verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents several background automations that act on incoming mail without user action. Auto Labels classify messages as they arrive, Auto Archive clears low-priority mail, and Auto Drafts plus follow-up reminders are generated automatically. Users can configure these with custom AI-prompt labels and plain-language instructions, and a builder (chat or visual) creates agents that run proactively on user-set triggers. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the trigger-based agent builder and clarity that it applies to Mail itself; custom Auto Labels are limited to Business/Enterprise plans; no independent or hands-on corroboration that the background automations work reliably.
